name: high_priest_of_the_order
description: a High Priest of the Order (Fall from Heaven), an old cleric with white hair and a white beard, a tall white mitre with a red sun emblem and gold trim, a red-and-gold cope with gold crosses over long white robes, a gold chain with a gold sun medallion on his chest, brown shoes, and a tall golden crosier topped by a golden sunburst with a gold orb in his RIGHT hand (screen-left); his LEFT hand (screen-right) is raised empty in blessing
hands: the golden sunburst crosier stays upright in his right hand on the screen-left side and his left hand is an empty open hand raised in blessing on the screen-right side

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, the tall white mitre jolting, torso jolts back, the arms jerk (the crosier arm yanked down to his hip on the screen-left side, still gripping the golden sunburst crosier, which tips back so its sunburst rises beside his head; his empty open left hand thrown up on the screen-right side)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the crosier hand low at his hip on the screen-left side, the golden sunburst crosier still in it and slanting across his body toward his head, his empty open left hand still raised on the screen-right side

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, the crosier arm flung up holding the golden sunburst crosier high, his empty left hand drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head with its white mitre droops, the golden crosier lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the sunburst end of the golden crosier resting on the ground at the lower-right, his empty left arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the golden crosier slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the red-and-gold cope flaring
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the white mitre still on his head; the golden sunburst crosier lies on the ground at the lower-right; the red-and-gold cope spread under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the red-and-gold cope settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the golden sunburst crosier on the ground beside him
